title: Stop the duplicate-key warnings on a Space website whose menu items share a link

source.ref: Visual sweep 2026-11-02: /themes/nocturne/demo logs 'Encountered two children with the same key' on every load; /themes/nocturne embeds it

detail:
The Space website chrome keyed its header nav links, mobile menu entries and footer link list on href alone. The Nocturne demo site points its four menu items (Offerings, Gatherings, Journeys, Membership) at the demo home, so React saw four children with one key, warned on every render and can drop or duplicate entries on update. Any real site with two menu items on one page would do the same. Keys now carry href and label.

 Fixed 2026-11-02; browser check: /themes/nocturne/demo logs no duplicate-key warning.
